content: Popeye is a live-cluster best-practice sanitizer (point-in-time lint, scores, unused resources, probes, limits)—not an offline support-bundle RCA tool. K8sGPT is live analyze + optional LLM --explain, dump for tooling debug, MCP/auto-remediation directions—different product class from archive heuristics. Support-bundle analyzers operate on collected archives with fail/warn/pass hints; complementary to collect-first tools like groot.
